comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides the AMD Vivado Design Suite for hardware design teams to program FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs, the Vitis unified software platform for embedded and accelerated application development, and the Vitis AI platform for developing and deploying AI software on these devices.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose specific software platforms developed to accelerate AI workloads on their hardware. NVIDIA offers 'NVIDIA AI Enterprise' as a comprehensive suite of paid licenses for enterprise-grade AI software, which is integral to its data center computing platform. AMD similarly provides the 'Vitis AI unified software platform' to enable the development and deployment of AI software on its FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs. While NVIDIA's offering is framed as a paid software license suite integrated with its GPUs, AMD's is described as a unified software platform for embedded and accelerated applications, highlighting a parallel focus on providing software ecosystems to support hardware-based AI acceleration, though the specific products (NVIDIA AI Enterprise vs. Vitis AI) and target hardware (Data Center GPUs vs. FPGAs/Adaptive SoCs) differ.

sentences.text: In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations.
Our Vitis AI unified software platform enables the development and deployment of AI software on our FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs.
